coverage_notes: CMS Public Notices was checked first. The CMS-domain search completed, but the current Public Notices/Termination Notices page itself was not retrievable through the web tool, so the official-notice leg is incomplete and this run is DEGRADED. Exactly 12 additional targeted searches were completed across hospital/ED, maternity, behavioral health, dialysis/oncology, primary care, rural/emergency service loss, ambulance, air-medical, restoration/reopening, U.S. territories, official state notices, and provider/CLIA actions. No new qualifying U.S. or territory healthcare-access change was identified in the bounded window. An Illinois notice concerning proposed discontinuation of Choate Mental Health and Developmental Center's 75-bed inpatient psychiatric unit was excluded because it is a proposal with no concrete access effect yet. Providence St. Joseph Rural Health Clinic and Loma Linda's EmPATH unit were excluded because they are planned/new service expansions rather than restorations of previously lost essential service. Historical, non-U.S., proposal-only, ownership-only, unsupported, and duplicate items were excluded.
